title: Bottle Fill Puzzle
description: Drop bouncy fruits and clever physics shapes into quirky glass jars—pack every piece cleanly below the rim line without a single overflow.
controls: Tap or drag horizontally above the bottle mouth to position each item and drop it neatly inside the jar.

zh-CN.title: 烧脑挑战装满瓶子
zh-CN.description: 抖音魔性物理装瓶收纳挑战：看准水果尺寸和物理弹跳落点逐一投入玻璃瓶，完美塞满不溢出才算真高手！
zh-CN.controls: 按住拖动控制上方水果投放位置，松手下落将所有水果稳稳装入玻璃瓶中不溢出。
